name: memarium-plugin
description: Memarium Claude Code plugin — digest Claude Code, Copilot Chat, and Codex sessions into a per-project typed Memory OS, then recall it before work. Standalone, no extra CLI required.

plugins.name: memarium
plugins.description: /memarium digests Claude Code, Copilot Chat, and Codex sessions into typed memory (episodic / semantic / procedural / core) + an entity wiki + distilled Q&A. A SessionStart hook auto-injects the project primer; /memarium-context and /memarium-recall provide deeper retrieval.
